title: Adopt audited Phase 1 execution sequence
decision: Use the frozen P1.0–P1.11 roadmap from control and beachhead through final no-invention validation.
consequences: v0.1 sequence is superseded; its domain content remains provisional evidence.

title: Treat cost ledger as commercial event substrate, not presumed full GL
decision: Use one canonical commercial effect/event substrate sufficient for product balances; do not presume a full GL.
consequences: P07 owns product commercial effects; ERP retains configured accounting/AP/cash authority.

title: Procurement structural root
decision: Use a polycentric graph: requirement source → RequirementAllocation → optional package → sourcing → AwardDecision → handoff or Commitment; no universal root.
consequences: Navigation may project across identities but cannot create a root.

title: PO and Subcontract type model
decision: Use one semantic Commitment core with bounded kinds/profiles; keep ScopeBasis, ValuationBasis and CapabilityProfile distinct; use one CommercialEffectVector algebra.
consequences: New mechanisms require prospective controlled extension.

title: Accounting and commercial ownership seam
decision: Product owns activated procurement/commercial truth; external accounting owns configured AP/liability, payment/cash, GL close and accounting postings; no co-master.
consequences: Certification, posting and payment remain distinct and reconciled.

title: V1 ERP/accounting integration depth
decision: Mandatory native/manual A0–A3, structured-file and provider-neutral internal integration/email substrate; named/deep connectors are optional evidence-driven activations.
consequences: At least one conforming email adapter is selected for deployment, but no named connector is required before first tender.

title: Long-lead tracking object model
decision: Use thin milestone instances anchored to existing requirement/package/tender/award/Commitment/component/external lineage; no universal TrackedItem.
consequences: Required/planned/forecast/confirmed/actual remain distinct.

title: Workflow engine generality in V1
decision: Use bounded product-defined approval/control primitives; workflow outcomes feed deterministic domain commands and never write truth.
consequences: Tenant-authored state machines, effects and expressions are prohibited.

title: Configuration breadth in V1
decision: Use constrained typed versioned auditable product-supported configuration; no arbitrary formulas, events, states or capability graphs.
consequences: New semantic members require architecture change.

title: GCC commercial semantics versus late localization
decision: Common semantic seams are frozen; exact UAE/GCC rates, statutory timing, legal defaults, formalities and retention remain evidence-driven.
consequences: Later evidence may populate bounded policies but cannot redefine frozen effects.

title: Budget and cost attribution timing
decision: Sourcing may precede final coding where policy permits; effective Commitment requires final attribution or governed visible suspense with resolution gates. Detailed mechanics remain later.
consequences: Detailed task/storage mechanics are non-SPINE refinement.

title: External vendor identity and access model
decision: Use tenant-private supplier relationships and grants with optional reusable technical authentication; guest/email/account/buyer-capture may coexist; no cross-tenant business profile/grant import.
consequences: Authentication technology remains physical; business relationships remain tenant-private.

title: Event-derived procurement status versus manual trackers
decision: REQUIRED/PLANNED/FORECAST/CONFIRMED are versioned planning/observation facts; ACTUAL derives from canonical or authoritative external events.
consequences: P10 remains a thin expediting overlay.

title: Document provenance ownership and depth
decision: Use a bounded first-class evidence substrate for product-governed evidence and exact issued versions; external masters remain reference/narrow mirror; disposition preserves identity and meaning.
consequences: Storage and jurisdictional retention remain physical/legal work.

title: Posting finalization reversal and correction semantics
decision: Use immutable typed effects with non-economic amendment, reverse/replace, forward adjustment, source reversal, reclassification and integration-only correction; no economic in-place rewrite.
consequences: Period/integration policy selects permitted mode without rewriting truth.

title: External-party UX priority
decision: Use a bounded hybrid: secure task link and email/file minimum, governed buyer-on-behalf fallback, optional tenant-scoped workspace, product-owned field/schema grammar, exact receipt/disposition and no network/profile.
consequences: Primary supplier UX evidence remains mandatory before non-throwaway build.

title: AI-readiness deterministic substrate
decision: AI is optional replaceable proposal/orchestration over provenance, registered operations, reports and confirmation; AI-off/manual A0–A3 remains complete.
consequences: Product-owned capability registry and isolation/evaluation/authority limits are mandatory.

title: Workflow-to-financial-state seam
decision: Workflow/approval outcomes may authorize a bounded domain command but never become commercial/accounting truth.
consequences: All financial changes route through domain operations.

title: Effective dating and temporal authority semantics
decision: Preserve immutable identity/recorded time, material effective time/period, governing versions and correction lineage; historical interpretation uses bound versions.
consequences: Physical storage remains implementation choice.

title: Configuration binding for in-flight instances
decision: Bind load-bearing policy/config versions; check current security for new actions; change requires governed migration/re-evaluation.
consequences: No silent rebinding.

title: Field-level integration authority and staleness
decision: Use fact/event-grain OWN/MIRROR/REFERENCE/OUT, one writer per period, visible freshness/conflict and governed cutover.
consequences: Connector is never authority.

title: Money representation rounding and calculation order
decision: Use exact decimal money and versioned calculation policy with ordered stages, purpose-specific FX/tax and correction.
consequences: Physical numeric/storage library remains later.

title: Numbering under concurrency retries and fiscal rules
decision: Separate immutable internal identity from versioned display-number policy; use idempotency and atomic invariants.
consequences: No universal gapless promise without evidence.

title: Adopt two irreversible pre-model substrate constraints
decision: Every significant truth supports source/version/location provenance; every state change is a bounded domain/service action.
consequences: Does not assume AI success.

title: Data residency region declaration and governed migration
decision: Declare tenant primary residency categories and govern region migration/in-flight/copy disposition; classify every later processing path.
consequences: No UAE/GCC localization claim is made.

title: Cross-tenant data isolation and shared-learning boundary
decision: Tenant business data must not influence another tenant by default across retrieval, embeddings, memory, evaluation, training or providers; shared executable infrastructure is allowed with scoped context.
consequences: Future shared-learning mode requires separate governance and honest withdrawal.

title: Evidence identity version content-integrity and reconstruction-anchor model
decision: Separate record/version/content integrity/source/capture/location/binding/reliance; require reconstruction anchor or permitted immutable capture.
consequences: Physical storage/indexing remains later.

title: Communication transmittal delivery acknowledgment and domain-effect boundary
decision: Keep communication facts distinct; frozen satisfaction rule creates canonical snapshot; owning domain establishes one effect once; later evidence cannot silently reverse/retime it.
consequences: Consequence changes require owning-domain correction.

title: Capability-neutral bounded interface substrate
decision: Use one OperationRegistry with QUERY/PROPOSAL/COMMAND/ASYNC_OPERATION, governed capability lifecycle, authorization-filtered tools and no raw mutation.
consequences: Manual deterministic fallback is mandatory.

title: Domain integration event and immutable publication-recovery boundary
decision: Separate domain/integration/transport/observation; bind immutable PublicationIntent with original source, mapping, disclosure and target; new semantics create new publication/operation.
consequences: Physical outbox/broker remains later.

title: Connector execution authority effect uncertainty and conformance
decision: Use closed authority modes, fact-grain mapping and seven effect stages; positive proof required for no effect; indeterminate blocks retry/rebind and permits reconciliation/manual/block only.
consequences: Unresolved positions may close operationally without asserting no effect.

title: Migration truth provenance and limitation
decision: Use explicit migration classes, immutable manifests and domain acceptance profiles; no direct state/balance assignment; block or import as reference-limited where insufficient.
consequences: Physical ETL remains later.

title: Metric semantic authority and partial-population grammar
decision: Use immutable versioned metric grammar with source/grain/contribution/population/time/quality/access and one closed partial-population treatment; controlled operator registry only.
consequences: Unknown population cannot become a point subtotal.

title: Projection report snapshot restatement use and reliance
decision: Separate definitions/executions/results/snapshots/artifacts/issues/restatements; issued snapshots immutable; current reliance reassessed separately from issue-time eligibility.
consequences: Forwarded copies carry status/restatement context; recall not promised.

title: Time status actual and forecast reporting semantics
decision: Use explicit time bases and REQUIRED/PLANNED/FORECAST/CONFIRMED/ACTUAL/SCENARIO/TARGET; generic ACTUAL invalid; physical/certified/posted/paid distinct.
consequences: Unlike actual families are not summed/substituted.

title: Result quality materiality and decision-use eligibility
decision: Use full quality vector and per-use disposition, versioned materiality policy and report-use composition; subset results cannot support commercial approval/external/audit use.
consequences: Missing policy blocks load-bearing use.

title: Contribution comparability and partial-population aggregation
decision: Use occurrence/lineage/conservation identities, additivity declaration and target-scope quality/population/comparability rule; restricted members never redefine denominator.
consequences: Cross-tenant aggregation/influence remains OUT.

title: Operation interaction continuation bulk and typed outcome
decision: Bind every affordance to an interaction class and registered operation; require exact preview/principal confirmation, retrievable pre-transmission continuation, typed outcome and four bulk modes.
consequences: No blind retry or false external atomicity.

title: Work context navigation and no second root
decision: Use polycentric work context linking canonical subjects; tasks, queues and saved views are derived and cannot write state.
consequences: Every action remains operation-owned.

title: Load-bearing disclosure history and reliance interaction
decision: Use load-bearing disclosure bundle, mandatory placement profiles and parity manifest; distinguish current/issued/restated and current reliance; receipts include disposition/non-meaning.
consequences: Surfaces unable to preserve meaning are prohibited.

title: Safe recovery accessibility localization and conventional-chat coexistence
decision: Use typed recovery, no generic retry under possible effect, WCAG 2.2 AA target, mobile/RTL/locale semantics and complete conventional equivalents for chat/AI.
consequences: Physical UI/test tooling remains later.

title: Measurable workload performance and NFR conformance
decision: Every NFR binds workload/SLI/population/window/threshold/criticality/evidence and closed conformance; missing telemetry cannot improve claims; lower envelopes are prospective and contract-aware.
consequences: C0 cannot be waived or lowered.

title: Availability durability continuity reliability and degradation
decision: Use semantic RPO 0 for acknowledged critical records, four durability proofs, capability RTO/RPO, tested restore, typed retry/effect uncertainty and deterministic degradation order.
consequences: AI and optional features degrade before A0–A3.

title: Observability security privacy residency lifecycle data and resource residual
decision: Separate telemetry from truth; apply measurable security/privacy/residency/lifecycle to primary and derived copies; finite file/import/export/quota/deployment contracts; no generic platform scope.
consequences: Physical vendors/tools remain later.

title: Product-owned AI run proposal provenance context abstention and evaluation grammar
decision: Product-authored capability/run/prompt/source/context/evaluation/resource grammar; exact provenance; context population dispositions; proposal freshness; statistically sufficient evaluation; abstention.
consequences: Only current SUFFICIENT_PASS activates.

title: Product-owned bounded agent authority tool use and human-confirmed command
decision: Use product capability/tool/authority registry, narrower-only tenant profile with monotonicity proof, L0–L6 with no generative L6, exact same-principal L5 digest and intersection-only sub-agents.
consequences: Effect-indeterminate pauses continuation.

title: Tenant-isolated retrieval memory provider replacement and AI-off
decision: Scope prompts/retrieval/embeddings/cache/memory/evaluation/provider files by tenant/context/purpose/residency; independent profile evaluation; no provider training/cross-tenant influence; AI-off path complete.
consequences: Provider disappearance cannot block A0–A3.

title: Ordered architecture-to-evidence build pilot and commercial falsification gate
decision: Order architecture closure, contractor/supplier evidence, prototype comprehension, deterministic thin slice, P07 feasibility, NFR, AI, pilot and commercial decisions; evidence can revise/kill hypotheses.
consequences: Architecture PASS is never market/product/commercial validation.
